kpis_story.name_fr: Wins CopperEdge AEC pour AI data centers
kpis_story.description_fr: CopperEdge AEC (Active Electrical Cables) + FiberEdge (CDR) wins design chez hyperscalers AI 2024 (Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS, Meta) pour interconnects 800G/1.6T. Pure-play AI compute speed-link play.
kpis_story.description_en: CopperEdge AEC (Active Electrical Cables) + FiberEdge (CDR) design wins at AI hyperscalers 2024 (Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS, Meta) for 800G/1.6T interconnects. Pure-play AI compute speed-link play.

_notes: Mixed-signal semis (AI exposure). Source: 10-K FY25 filed Mar 2025.
